concept.subject: Three round pumpkins resting in the long grass of the patch at dusk, two in front and one behind them, each with a crooked stem.
concept.composition: The left pumpkin, the smallest, spans from a ninth to two fifths of the width, its top at two fifths of the height and its stem leaning left. The right pumpkin, the biggest, spans from half to nine tenths of the width, its crest at a third of the height and a tall curling stem left of its middle. The back pumpkin shows between and above them, its top at a quarter of the height and its short stem just left of the cannon. Long grass fills the bottom fifth and the lower corners; the misty patch above the pumpkins is open under the cannon.
concept.layout: Round pegs only, 141. Each pumpkin is drawn by its outline and its grooves: peg lines along its crest and sides and down its ribs. The right pumpkin's crest, from beside its stem over the top and down its right side, and the back pumpkin's crest running down into the left pumpkin's crest are chains at the 34 px minimum spacing that one shot can light almost whole; the back pumpkin's crest right of its stem drops into the right pumpkin's left side, a hollow that catches shots near straight down. The three stems are solids that shelter the pegs at their feet. Two rows of pegs are the grass along the bottom and six pegs the long grass beside the pumpkins; the sky over the pumpkins stays open.

difficulty.note: Second easiest: the crests and the hollow between the pumpkins light many pegs per shot, while the stems shelter the back pumpkin's crest and the ribs at their feet, where the orange pegs gather, and the open sky over the pumpkins gives nothing to bounce on.

background.prompt: A close photo of three round pumpkins resting in long grass, seen from the side at their own height, in dusty rose against the gray-mauve, out-of-focus patch. The left pumpkin, the smallest, spans from about a ninth to two fifths of the width with its top at about two fifths of the height and a crooked stem leaning left at about a quarter of the width. The right pumpkin, the biggest, spans from about half to nine tenths of the width with its crest at about a third of the height and a tall curling stem at about two thirds of the width. The third pumpkin sits behind them between, its top at about a quarter of the height and its short stem just left of the center. Long grass fills the bottom fifth and the lower corners; above the pumpkins the blurred patch is plain, calm at the top center.

picture.title: Three orange pumpkins sitting on green grass, perfect for autumn themes.
